targets.rawSql:
SELECT
		timestamp          AS time,
		device,
		temperature__value AS temperature
	FROM (
		SELECT
			timestamp,
			regexp_replace(topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') AS "section",
			regexp_replace(topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/.*/([^/]+)$', '$1') AS device,
			topic,
			temperature__value
		FROM public.test_marpower__500000_thrs__temperatures
		WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
		ORDER BY timestamp ASC
	)
	WHERE "section" IN (${section:sqlstring})

SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic)
    timestamp                                                       AS time,
    regexp_replace(topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/.*/([^/]+)$', '$1') AS device,
    topic,
    regexp_replace(topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') AS "section",
    op_time__value                                                  AS operation_time
  FROM public.test_marpower__500000_thrs__pumps
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
	AND regexp_replace(topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') IN (${section:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY topic, timestamp DESC
